specific_objectives: 30.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the armament stores procedures

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of armament classification charts; Instructor supervision required for safety protocols
intro_questions: What is the primary function of aircraft armaments?
Can you list three types of weapon systems?
Why is proper classification of armaments essential for safety?

development.content:
Definition of armament stores
Internal vs external stores
Fixed vs removable stores
Guided vs unguided munitions
Conventional vs nuclear weapons

Classification by delivery method
Classification by warhead type
Storage and handling categories
Marking and identification codes
Compatibility with aircraft systems

Safety procedures during classification
Documentation requirements
Inspection and maintenance protocols
Emergency response for misclassified items
Record keeping and reporting

summary_questions: Explain the difference between internal and external armament stores.
How does the classification system impact storage and handling procedures?
What are the key safety considerations when classifying guided munitions?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note comparing gun warfare stores and magazine stores, focusing on their classification differences, to be discussed in Lesson Plan 02.
